name: Po(tu)storonnie v...
source: A famous content creator decides to spice up her channel with a video investigating an abandoned house said to be haunted by strange occurrences. However, the trip turns into something far more terrifying than she expected...
translation: 一位知名视频博主为了给自己的频道增加看点，决定前往一栋据传怪事频发的废弃老宅拍摄探秘视频。然而，这趟行程却演变成了一场远超她预料的恐怖噩梦……
